passages.provision_quote: shall not install a new sharrow on a highway that has a posted speed limit greater than 30 miles per hour, except at or near an intersection for the purpose of connecting a Class I, Class II, or Class IV bikeway through the intersection
passages.note: Author of a bikeway design/safety standard (bans new sharrows on roads over 30 mph; restricts ATP funding for sharrow projects), not an investment-priority choice between roads and active modes.

rows.reasoning: SB 1216 is a bikeway design and safety standard (prohibiting new sharrows on roads over 30 mph and limiting Active Transportation Program funding for sharrow projects); it does not address where government should focus transportation investment between road capacity and multimodal/active modes, so the passage is adjacent and cannot support a chair.
needs_source: A record or statement from Blakespear addressing the balance of transportation investment between road capacity and active transportation/transit (e.g., a transportation budget vote, a roads-vs-transit funding bill, or her own words on investment priorities).
